quotes.text: Paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals describe uncertainty in the change in strict pass@1 , measured in percentage points.

parsed.rationale: Paired-bootstrap CIs are reported for the step-cap ablation and the SFT and RL comparisons on 50 tasks. The headline 31-model leaderboard (Tables 2 and 7) has no CI or test, so the ranking claims are untested.
